spec.description: Activity, waits, locks, memory, databases and availability replicas of one SQL Server instance on a Windows host.
mssql sub-collectors that failed at the last scrape for this SQL Server instance. The Exporter tab shows the scrape errors. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Sub-collector failures

spec.description: Users connected to the instance. Each user can have several connections. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: User connections

spec.description: Transact-SQL command batches received per second. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Batch requests

spec.description: Processes currently blocked by another process. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Blocked processes

spec.description: Lock requests per minute that resulted in a deadlock, across all lock resource types. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Deadlocks

spec.description: Processes waiting for a workspace memory grant to run a query. Values above zero mean queries wait for memory. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Pending memory grants

spec.description: Seconds a page stays in the buffer pool without references. A falling value means the buffer pool is under memory pressure. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Page life expectancy

spec.description: Share of page lookups found in the buffer pool without a disk read, over the most recent SQL Server sampling interval. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Buffer cache hit ratio

spec.description: Transact-SQL batches, query compilations and recompilations per second. Many compilations per batch can indicate plans that are not reused. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Batch requests and compilations

spec.description: Users connected to the instance, and logical connections to it. Each user can have several connections. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Connections

spec.description: Index searches, unrestricted full scans and page splits per second. Full scans of large tables and many page splits can indicate missing indexes or a low fill factor. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Access methods

spec.description: Errors per second by error class. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: SQL errors

spec.description: Logins, logouts and connection resets from the connection pool per second. Logouts are drawn below the axis. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Logins and logouts

spec.expr: windows_mssql_waitstats_lock_waits{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", item="Cumulative wait time (ms) per second"} / 1000
windows_mssql_waitstats_memory_grant_queue_waits{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", item="Cumulative wait time (ms) per second"} / 1000
windows_mssql_waitstats_thread_safe_memory_objects_waits{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", item="Cumulative wait time (ms) per second"} / 1000
windows_mssql_waitstats_log_write_waits{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", item="Cumulative wait time (ms) per second"} / 1000
windows_mssql_waitstats_log_buffer_waits{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", item="Cumulative wait time (ms) per second"} / 1000
windows_mssql_waitstats_network_io_waits{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", item="Cumulative wait time (ms) per second"} / 1000
windows_mssql_waitstats_page_io_latch_waits{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", item="Cumulative wait time (ms) per second"} / 1000
windows_mssql_waitstats_page_latch_waits{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", item="Cumulative wait time (ms) per second"} / 1000
windows_mssql_waitstats_nonpage_latch_waits{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", item="Cumulative wait time (ms) per second"} / 1000
windows_mssql_waitstats_wait_for_the_worker_waits{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", item="Cumulative wait time (ms) per second"} / 1000
windows_mssql_waitstats_workspace_synchronization_waits{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", item="Cumulative wait time (ms) per second"} / 1000
windows_mssql_waitstats_transaction_ownership_waits{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", item="Cumulative wait time (ms) per second"} / 1000

spec.description: Time sessions spent waiting per second, by wait class, over the most recent SQL Server sampling interval. 2 s means two sessions waited the whole second on average. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Wait time by wait class

spec.description: Lock requests per second that had to wait, by lock resource type. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Lock waits

spec.description: Average wait time of the lock requests that waited, by lock resource type. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Average lock wait

spec.description: Lock requests per second that resulted in a deadlock or timed out, across all lock resource types. Timeouts exclude NOWAIT requests. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Deadlocks and lock timeouts

spec.description: Memory the memory manager has committed, against the memory it can use. The total stays below the target when SQL Server needs no more memory. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Server memory

spec.description: Server memory used for cached database pages, the plan cache, the query optimizer, locks, the log pool and connections, and memory not in use. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Memory by consumer

spec.description: Seconds a page stays in the buffer pool without references. Sudden drops mean pages are evicted to make room, for example for a large scan. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Page life expectancy

spec.description: Bytes per second the buffer pool reads, reads ahead, and writes through checkpoints, the lazy writer and other page writes. Reads are drawn below the axis. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Buffer pool I/O

spec.description: Processes that received a workspace memory grant, and processes waiting for one. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Memory grants

spec.description: Size, log usage and activity of each selected database. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Databases

spec.description: Size of the data files of each selected database. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Data file size

spec.description: Share of the log files of each selected database in use. A log that stays full needs a log backup, a checkpoint or more space. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Log used

spec.description: Transactions started per second in each selected database. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Transactions

spec.description: Bytes per second written to the transaction log of each selected database. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Log flushes

spec.expr: max by (database) (rate(windows_mssql_databases_log_flush_write_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", database=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval]) / (rate(windows_mssql_databases_log_flushes{job=~"$job", instance="$instance", mssql_instance="$mssql_instance", database=~"$database"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))

spec.description: Average time to write a log flush to disk in each selected database. Commits wait for this write, so slow log storage slows every write transaction. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Log flush write time

spec.description: Free space in tempdb and the size of the version store kept in it for snapshot isolation and online index operations. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: tempdb space

spec.description: Seconds since the start of the oldest active transaction that uses row versioning. A long transaction keeps the version store from shrinking. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Longest running transaction

spec.description: Active transactions, and the ones among them that use snapshot isolation or generate row versions. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Active transactions

spec.description: Log waiting to be sent to each secondary replica, and log received and waiting to be redone on it. Only hosts in an Always On availability group report replicas. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Replica queues

spec.description: Bytes per second sent to and received from each availability replica. Received bytes are drawn below the axis. Requires the mssql collector, which is not enabled by default.
spec.title: Replica traffic
Windows Exporter / MSSQL
